question.text: A bandwidth of <math><mn>10 </mn><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">z</mi></math> is available for <math><mi mathvariant="normal">A</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi></math> transmission. If the maximum audio signal frequency used for modulating the carrier is not to exceed <math><mn>5 </mn><mtext>kHz,</mtext></math> how many stations can be broadcasted within this band simultaneously without interfering with each other?

solution.text:
Bandwidth required for each station
=2× maximum frequency of audio signal
2×5=10kHz
Number of stations which can be broadcast within bandwidth of 10MHz
=10×10610×103=1000
